name: timing
title: Timing exercise (12-bit multiplier)
description: A multiplier between two rows of registers, set to a 5 ns clock it can't meet: the run fails setup timing on purpose. Read the failure card, then find the clock it passes at. At 10 ns LibreLane passes it: the typical corner meets with time to spare, and the slow corner (ss: slow transistors, hot, low voltage) still misses by under a nanosecond, which LibreLane reports as a warning.
teaches: Slack, WNS and TNS, logic depth, the clock period and corners: it fails at 5 ns and passes at 10.
